versions.changelog:
Initial release of WeChat Business Article Writer.

- Generate WeChat public account style articles on business and technology topics.
- Emphasizes professional yet approachable tone with personal perspective and plain language.
- Provides clear structure templates for business articles and product reviews.
- Includes practical writing guidelines and editorial checklist for quality assurance.
- Designed to avoid AI-like or corporate jargon, focusing on authentic, readable content.
